name: sipsak
summary: A small command line tool for developers and administrators of Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) applications.
highlights: --filename — the file which contains the SIP message to send use - for standard input
--sip-uri — the destination server URI in form sip:[user@]servername[:port]
--invite-mode — simulates a successful calls with itself
--contact — use the given URI as Contact in REGISTER

flags.name: --help
flags.description: displays this help message

flags.name: --version
flags.description: prints version string only

flags.name: --filename
flags.description: the file which contains the SIP message to send use - for standard input

flags.name: --no-crlf
flags.description: de-activate CR (\r) insertion

flags.name: --sip-uri
flags.description: the destination server URI in form sip:[user@]servername[:port]

flags.name: --traceroute
flags.description: activates the traceroute mode

flags.name: --usrloc-mode
flags.description: activates the usrloc mode

flags.name: --invite-mode
flags.description: simulates a successful calls with itself

flags.name: --message-mode
flags.description: sends messages to itself

flags.name: --contact
flags.description: use the given URI as Contact in REGISTER

flags.name: --appendix-begin
flags.description: the starting number appendix to the user name (default: 0)

flags.name: --appendix-end
flags.description: the ending number of the appendix to the user name

flags.name: --sleep
flags.description: sleep number ms before sending next request

flags.name: --expires
flags.description: the expires header field value (default: 15)

flags.name: --remove-bindings
flags.description: activates randomly removing of user bindings

flags.name: --flood-mode
flags.description: activates the flood mode

flags.name: --random-mode
flags.description: activates the random mode (dangerous)

flags.name: --trash-chars
flags.description: the maximum number of trashed character in random mode (default: request length)

flags.name: --local-port
flags.description: the local port to use (default: any)

flags.name: --remote-port
flags.description: the remote port to use (default: 5060)

flags.name: --outbound-proxy
flags.description: request target (outbound proxy)

flags.name: --hostname
flags.description: overwrites the local hostname in all headers

flags.name: --max-forwards
flags.description: the value for the max-forwards header field

flags.name: --numeric
flags.description: use FQDN instead of IP in the Via-Line

flags.name: --processes
flags.description: Divide the workflow among the number of processes

flags.name: --auth-username
flags.description: username for authentication

flags.name: --no-via
flags.description: deactivate the insertion of a Via-Line

flags.name: --password
flags.description: password for authentication (if omitted password=username)

flags.name: --ignore-redirects
flags.description: ignore redirects

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: each v produces more verbosity (max. 3)

flags.name: --extract-ip
flags.description: extract IP from the warning in reply

flags.name: --replace-string
flags.description: replacement for a special mark in the message

flags.name: --replace
flags.description: activates replacement of variables

flags.name: --nagios-code
flags.description: returns exit codes Nagios compliant

flags.name: --nagios-warn
flags.description: return Nagios warning if retrans > number

flags.name: --message-body
flags.description: send a message with string as body

flags.name: --disposition
flags.description: Content-Disposition value

flags.name: --search
flags.description: search for a RegExp in replies and return error on failure

flags.name: --timing
flags.description: number of test runs and print just the timings

flags.name: --symmetric
flags.description: send and received on the same port

flags.name: --from
flags.description: use the given URI as From in MESSAGE

flags.name: --timeout-factor
flags.description: timeout multiplier for INVITE transactions on non-reliable transports (default: 64)

flags.name: --timer-t1
flags.description: timeout T1 in ms (default: 500)

flags.name: --transport
flags.description: specify transport to be used

flags.name: --headers
flags.description: adds additional headers to the request

flags.name: --local-ip
flags.description: specify local ip address to be used

flags.name: --authhash
flags.description: HA1 hash for authentication instead of password

flags.name: --syslog
flags.description: log exit message to syslog with given log level

flags.name: --tls-ca-cert
flags.description: file with the cert of the root CA

flags.name: --tls-client-cert
flags.description: file with the cert which sipsak will send

flags.name: --tls-ignore-cert-failure
flags.description: ignore failures during the TLS handshake
